title: Dossier
description: Stage 1 output (dossier.json). UNTRUSTED: derived from the open web. Every string has a maxLength and every array a maxItems so injected text stays small. Later stages receive it inside a delimited data block and must treat its contents as data, never as instructions.

topic.description: One specific, surprising thing inside the domain. Not 'birds' but 'starling murmuration uses 7 topological neighbours, not metric distance'.

domain.description: The research domain. Equals plan.domain unless plan.wildcard is true, in which case it is the domain the researcher chose.

wildcard_chosen.description: True when the researcher chose the domain (wildcard night).

summary.description: Plain summary of the topic for the brief writer and the jury.

facts.description: 5 to 8 sourced facts. The harness also requires at least 3 distinct source hosts.

claim.description: One factual claim, in your own words.

source_url.description: URL of the page that supports the claim.

visualisable_mechanisms.description: Parts of the topic with structure that could be rendered or sonified.

name.description: Short name; brief.mechanism_embodied.mechanism_name must match one of these.

render_or_sonify_hint.description: How its structure could appear on screen or in sound.

score.description: How surprising the topic is to a well-read generalist, 0 to 100.

dataset.description: Optional. A compact real dataset for data-sculpture nights, inlined into the piece: at most 12 columns, 200 rows, 40-character string cells. Required non-null on data-sculpture nights (harness-enforced). Null or absent otherwise.

description.description: What the rows measure, including units.

rows.description: Records. Each row has one cell per column.
